families.trend-pullback: EMA20>EMA50; previous close<=previous EMA20, current close>current EMA20. Stop=close-2*ATR14, target=close+3 structural R.
families.breakout: EMA20>EMA50; current close>maximum HIGH of preceding 20 completed bars; volume>=mean preceding 20 volumes. Stop=close-2*ATR14, target=close+3 structural R.
families.mean-reversion: Previous close below previous Bollinger lower20 (2 population stdev); current close reclaims current lower20; SMA-RSI14<=40. Stop=close-2*ATR14; target=EMA20.

signalConventions: Only complete UTC-aligned higher-timeframe bars with all underlying 5m bars; no gap filling. Require 60 consecutive higher-timeframe bars. EMA recalculated on latest 60 bars; previous EMA on the preceding 60 bars when available, otherwise preceding 59. Signal rising edges only; available at higher-bar close+1ms. No Strict BUY journal dependency.
benchmarks: EUR cash and buy-and-hold targeting equal weights in the four assets, using the same modeled costs and volume participation. Actual fills can leave uninvested cash and unequal weights; exposure is reported. No stops or open-risk constraint on passive reference; it is not a risk-matched strategy competitor.
dataPolicy: Reuse existing cache and original-vintage priority unchanged. Record revisions and flag affected windows including indicator warmup. Missing bars remain absent. Reject checksum corruption.
inference: Historical exploratory comparison; no parameter optimization, no automatic winner. Overview overlaps the splits and is not independent validation. Chronological final window is retrospective, not pristine prospective evidence. Future data after cutoff remain unevaluated.
safety: Research branch only. No frozen engines/protocol edits, no live changes, orders, deployment or main merge.
documentationAmendment: After first outcomes, expose actual passive investment/cash and correct the full-exposure description. No model rule, threshold, execution price, portfolio constraint or prior economic result is changed.
